sentences.text: My name is Emili, and I'm very happy you are here today.
In this episode, we will talk about
a small and interesting country.
This country is called Brunei.
Brunei is in Asia, and it is full of history,
nature, and culture.
I will speak slowly and clearly so you can understand.
Let's begin.
Where is Brunei?
Brunei is a small country in Southeast Asia.
It is located on the island of Borneo.
Brunei shares the island with two other countries,
Malaysia and Indonesia.
Brunei is next to the South China Sea.
It has beaches, forests, and small towns.
The capital city of Brunei is Bandar-Sari-Begawan.
It is a quiet and clean city.
The city has big mosques, markets, and museums.
Many people in Brunei live in or near this city.
What is Brunei famous for?
Brunei is famous for its wealth,
nature, and Islamic culture.
The country has a lot of oil and gas,
so the government is rich.
People in Brunei do not pay taxes,
and education and healthcare are free.
Brunei is also famous for its beautiful mosques.
One famous mosque is the Omar Ali-Sifudian mosque.
It has a big golden dome and is surrounded by water.
Another big mosque is Jam-asar-Hasanil-Bolchia Mosque,
which is also very beautiful and peaceful.
Brunei has many rainforests.
The country works hard to protect its trees and animals.
One popular place is Ulutemburong National Park.
People go there to walk in the forest,
climb towers, and see birds and monkeys.
What is the food like in Brunei?
The food in Brunei is tasty and full of flavor.
It is similar to Malay, Chinese, and Indian food.
People eat rice, noodles, meat, and fish.
Some popular dishes are Nasi Lamak,
rice with coconut milk, served with egg, peanuts,
cucumber, and spicy sauce.
Sate grilled meat on sticks, served with peanut sauce.
Meat goring, fried noodles with vegetables and meat.
Ambuyat, a sticky dish made from sago,
eaten with sour and spicy sauces.
For dessert, people enjoy kui,
which are small, sweet snacks,
often made with coconut and rice flour.
People also like tatari, a sweet milk tea,
and fruit juices made from tropical fruits
like mango and papaya.
Culture and people.
People in Brunei are very polite, respectful, and kind.
Most people in Brunei are Malay,
but there are also Chinese and indigenous groups.
The main language is Malay,
but many people speak English,
especially in schools and cities.
The main religion in Brunei is Islam.
People go to the mosque to pray, especially on Fridays.
Brunei follows Islamic laws,
and people wear modest clothes.
Men often wear shirts and trousers.
Women may wear a hijab, a headscarf.
People in Brunei love spending time with family.
Families eat meals together,
visit parks or go shopping.
People are very respectful to elders and teachers.
Nature and animals.
Brunei has amazing nature.
There are jungles, rivers, and beaches.
People can see monkeys, tropical birds,
butterflies, and lizards.
The proboscis monkey is a special animal that lives in Brunei.
It has a big nose and lives in the trees near the rivers.
Brunei's rainforests are very clean and quiet.
People can take boat rides,
forest walks, or sleep in ecologes.
The air is fresh, and the views are green and peaceful.
Festivals and celebrations.
One big celebration in Brunei is Hari Raya idol fishery.
It is the end of Ramadan,
the fasting month for Muslims.
People wear new clothes,
visit family and friends,
and eat special food.
The Sultan's birthday is also a big event.
The Sultan of Brunei is the king and leader of the country.
People celebrate his birthday with parades,
fireworks, and concerts.
Conclusion.
Brunei is a small but beautiful country.
It has kind people, peaceful cities,
green forests, and a rich culture.
It is a clean and quiet place with a lot to see and enjoy.
Would you like to visit Brunei one day?
I hope you learned something new today.
